decision.explanation: The original sources present three distinct individuals named Princess Elisabeth of Thurn and Taxis, each with separate birth dates: 15 December 1903 (D1S1), 24 March 1982 (D2S2), and 28 May 1860 (D3S3/D4S1/D5S5). These are valid referents with no evidence of contradiction between them. The R5_answers already include all three, so no changes are necessary.
